mapper.sql: SELECT tc.*, u.name AS author_name, op.name AS origin_project_name, rv.name AS reviewed_by_name, p.name AS project_name, f.name AS folder_name FROM test_case tc JOIN project p ON p.id = tc.project_id LEFT JOIN test_case_folder f ON f.id = tc.folder_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = tc.author_id LEFT JOIN project op ON op.id = tc.origin_project_id LEFT JOIN users rv ON rv.id = tc.reviewed_by

where.if: AND (LOWER(tc.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(tc.tc_code) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(tc.tags) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_case_requirement_link l WHERE l.test_case_id = tc.id AND l.atomic_requirement_id = #{atomicRequirementId})

mapper.select: SELECT j.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_step s WHERE s.test_case_id = j.id) AS step_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_case_requirement_link l WHERE l.test_case_id = j.id) AS requirement_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_case_dataset d WHERE d.test_case_id = j.id) AS dataset_count FROM ( ) j ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM test_step WHERE test_case_id = #{testCaseId} ORDER BY step_no
SELECT DISTINCT module FROM test_case WHERE module IS NOT NULL AND module != '' AND project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY module
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_case (tc_code, project_id, folder_id, title, module, precondition, priority, status, tags, is_parameterized, source, technique, review_status, origin_project_id, author_id) VALUES ((SELECT CONCAT('TC-', CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(tc_code, 4) AS INT)), 100) + 1, 101) AS VARCHAR)) FROM test_case WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(tc_code, '^TC-[0-9]+$')), #{projectId}, #{folderId}, #{title}, #{module}, #{precondition}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{tags}, #{isParameterized}, #{source}, #{technique}, #{reviewStatus}, #{originProjectId}, #{authorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case SET folder_id = #{folderId}, title = #{title}, module = #{module}, precondition = #{precondition}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, tags = #{tags}, technique = #{technique}, is_parameterized = #{isParameterized}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE test_case SET review_status = #{reviewStatus}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO test_step (test_case_id, step_no, action, expected_result) VALUES
(#{s.testCaseId}, #{s.stepNo}, #{s.action}, #{s.expectedResult})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS atomic_requirement_id, a.atomic_text, a.type, r.id AS requirement_id, r.req_code, r.title AS requirement_title FROM test_case_requirement_link l JOIN atomic_requirement a ON a.id = l.atomic_requirement_id JOIN requirement r ON r.id = a.requirement_id WHERE l.test_case_id = #{testCaseId} ORDER BY r.req_code, a.id

SELECT h.id, h.execution_id, h.result, h.comment, h.executed_at, u.name AS executed_by_name, c.id AS cycle_id, c.cycle_no, c.name AS cycle_name, d.id AS dataset_id, d.row_label AS dataset_label FROM test_execution_history h JOIN test_execution e ON e.id = h.execution_id JOIN test_cycle c ON c.id = e.cycle_id LEFT JOIN test_case_dataset d ON d.id = e.dataset_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = h.executed_by WHERE e.test_case_id = #{testCaseId} ORDER BY h.executed_at DESC, h.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_execution WHERE test_case_id = #{testCaseId}
